purpose: Related-work boundaries and interpretation constraints. Not a new protocol, result, authorization, or replacement of the frozen quality gate.
claim_under_test: At identical generator, starting history, hardware pool and wall budget, does allowing a ready execution to use any free execution GPU improve the best externally validated returned solution in both reversed-order repetitions?
not_novel_by_itself: Shared FIFO or removing fixed-device fragmentation
Resource or duration prediction from code/logs
Joint admission across model and tool resources

primary_sources.name: SchedMate
primary_sources.overlap: Semantic workload retrieval, progress extraction, failure handling and scheduling integration.
primary_sources.boundary: Simply adding code/log understanding to a scheduler is not our novelty.

primary_sources.name: MARS
primary_sources.overlap: GPU inference/CPU tool dual-pressure admission, multilevel feedback priority and opportunistic cache management; full-stack quality-preserving speedups.
primary_sources.boundary: The public preview is a relevant stronger-reference implementation, not installed or reproduced here. Its stack is not a drop-in change to our frozen task image.

primary_sources.name: PASTE: Act While Thinking
primary_sources.overlap: Pattern-aware speculative tool execution, slack budgets, priority and promotion to authoritative work.
primary_sources.boundary: No speculation or lookahead is introduced in the current approved experiment.

primary_sources.name: Budget-Aware Value Tree Search
primary_sources.overlap: Residual step values and remaining-budget-conditioned tree expansion.
primary_sources.boundary: The paper states its evaluated tool has uniform discrete cost; this difference does not prove a novel solution for our heterogeneous tools. No critic route is reopened.

primary_sources.name: ZEBRA
primary_sources.read_sections: Contribution summary, related work and D.16-D.18
primary_sources.overlap: LLM-estimated phase utility curves with constrained budget allocation; comparison against fixed average shares and controller overhead accounting.
primary_sources.boundary: A generic utility-per-budget allocator is not new. Its reported association between realized spending and quality is not by itself a causal guarantee of monotonic benefit in our search.

primary_sources.name: Inference-Time Budget Control for LLM Search Agents
primary_sources.overlap: Task-level marginal-value-per-budget action control under token/tool caps.
primary_sources.boundary: Only abstract/introduction reviewed; not a full reproduction or novelty exclusion for every detail.

primary_sources.name: PeakBench
primary_sources.read_sections: Scheduling metrics and Resource-Aware Scheduling Context
primary_sources.overlap: Separate logical planning from physical resource scheduling; provide measured tool resource profiles.
primary_sources.boundary: A resource-aware agent benchmark alone is not a new contribution here; our present test remains a real quality experiment, not a benchmark launch.

interpretation.if_gate_passes: Evidence of a useful resource-fragmentation effect under this fixed development setup, not a novel algorithm or broad cross-task confirmation. Any method must next outperform shared FIFO and applicable stronger scheduling references at inclusive cost.
interpretation.if_latency_improves_but_quality_gate_fai: Report only the system-level effect; do not claim final-score gains, change endpoints, or append a semantic selector to rescue this batch.
interpretation.if_infrastructure_fails: Close this batch with the complete assigned denominator and actual allocation cost; no scientific conclusion about pooling and no automatic retry.
interpretation.causal_limit: Scheduling changes both returned feedback timing and subsequent generated trajectories. A quality contrast identifies their combined effect, not a causal mediation result for feedback count, validity, or queue delay separately.
interpretation.replication_unit: Two reversed-order pool comparisons within one shared-service allocation; the 32 trajectories are not 32 independent treatment replications.
interpretation.scope: Two reused development tasks and a common historical warm start. No new tasks, official test, agent training, paid API, or historical-gain attribution.
